stodge.definition: n. heavy and filling (and usually starchy) food
stodge.translation:
n. 易饱的食物, 烤布丁, 步履艰难的人
vi. 狼吞虎咽, 艰难地行走
vt. 暴食, 使塞饱, 搀和, 使充分满足

stodged.translation: 充分满足( stodge的过去式和过去分词 )

stodges.translation: <英>易饱的不可口食物( stodge的名词复数 )

stodgier.definition:
s. heavy and starchy and hard to digest
s. (used pejoratively) out of fashion; old fashioned
s. excessively conventional and unimaginative and hence dull
stodgier.translation: a. <英, 贬>（食物）吃下去感觉撑的( stodgy的比较级 ); 易饱的; 滞涩的; 古板的

stodging.translation: 充分满足( stodge的现在分词 )

stodgy.definition:
s. heavy and starchy and hard to digest

stodgy.translation: a. 易吃饱的, 塞满的, 平凡的, 庸俗的, 步履艰难的
